title: Pocketwire Visa Debit Card Terms: Release of Overcharges Close to the On-Filing Ceiling
content:
**Cardholder terms, Pocketwire Visa Debit Card: credit on filing for single-use card overcharges.**

**1. Overcharge on record.** On an incorrect-amount dispute of a purchase made with a single-use virtual card, the overcharge on record is the disputed amount of the incorrect-amount disputes filed on the single-use card, less the disputed amount of those already resolved. The excess is the overcharge on record less the on-filing ceiling.

**2. Release rule.**
- (a) When the overcharge on record exceeds the on-filing ceiling by no more than 2.00, the whole overcharge on record is credited on filing.
- (b) When it exceeds the ceiling by more than 2.00, but no more than 5.00, the credit on filing is the ceiling plus half of the excess, rounded to the cent (half up).
- (c) In every other case, the credit on filing is the lower of the overcharge on record and the on-filing ceiling.

**3. An overcharge at or below the ceiling.** An overcharge on record at or below the ceiling exceeds it by no more than 2.00, so under 2(a) the whole overcharge on record is credited.

### Worked figures (hypothetical on-filing ceiling of 25.00)

| Overcharge on record | Excess over the ceiling | Rule | Credit on filing |
|---|---|---|---|
| 20.00 | below the ceiling | 2(a) | 20.00 |
| 26.50 | 1.50 | 2(a) | 26.50 |
| 27.00 | 2.00 | 2(a), since "no more than 2.00" includes 2.00 | 27.00 |
| 27.01 | 2.01 | 2(b) | 25.00 plus half of 2.01, which is 1.005 rounded half up to 1.01, giving 26.01 |
| 30.00 | 5.00 | 2(b) | 25.00 plus 2.50, which is 27.50 |
| 30.01 | 5.01 | 2(c) | 25.00, the lower |
